meta.titulo: Colima town festivals, month by month
meta.descripcion: A calendar of the patron saint festivals, fairs, cabalgatas and festivals of Colima's ten municipalities: dates, place and source for each one.

notaGeneral: Dates repeat every year and can shift by a few days. Tap a festival to see its source.
sinFiestasMes: No festivals listed for this month.
